entries.title: Job 11:1
segments: And Zophar the Naamathite answered and said,

entries.title: Job 11:2
segments: Should not the multitude of words be answered? And should a man full of talk be justified?

entries.title: Job 11:3
segments: Should your lies make men silent? And will you mock and no one make [you] ashamed?

entries.title: Job 11:4
segments: For you have said, My doctrine [is] pure, and I am clean in Your eyes.

entries.title: Job 11:5
segments: But who will grant that God would speak, and open His lips against you,

entries.title: Job 11:6
segments: and would tell you the secrets of His wisdom, that sound wisdom [is] manifold? Know therefore that God forgets for you [some] of your iniquity.

entries.title: Job 11:7
segments: Can you by searching find out God? Can you perfectly find out the Almighty?

entries.title: Job 11:8
segments: Heights of the heavens! What can you do? [It is] deeper than hell, what can you know?

entries.title: Job 11:9
segments: The measure of it [is] longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

entries.title: Job 11:10
segments: If He passes through and shuts up, or gathers together, then who can turn Him back?

entries.title: Job 11:11
segments: For He knows vain men; and when He sees wickedness, will He not search [it]?

entries.title: Job 11:12
segments: For foolish man would be wise, and man is born a wild ass's colt.

entries.title: Job 11:13
segments: If you prepare your heart and stretch out your hands toward Him;

entries.title: Job 11:14
segments: if iniquity [is] in your hand, put it far away, and do not let wickedness dwell in your tents;

entries.title: Job 11:15
segments: surely then you shall lift up your face without spot; yea, you shall be steadfast and shall not fear;

entries.title: Job 11:16
segments: for you shall forget [your] misery, and you shall remember [it] as waters that pass away.

entries.title: Job 11:17
segments: And [your] lifetime shall be clearer than the noonday; though [there be] darkness, you shall be as the morning.

entries.title: Job 11:18
segments: And you shall be safe, because there is hope; yea, you shall look around [you], and you shall take your rest in safety.

entries.title: Job 11:19
segments: You shall lie down, and none [shall] make you afraid. Yea, many shall seek your favor.

entries.title: Job 11:20
segments: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and they shall have no escape, and their hope [shall be like] the giving up of the spirit.
